SELECT v.vehiclereg AS VehicleID,
       v.shiptransit AS ShipmentID,
       ROUND(v.distdonekm / (v.distdonekm + v.distleftkm) * 100, 3) AS RouteCompletionPct,
       ROUND(MAX((1 - (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx) * (1 - c.coolremainpct / 100.0)), 3) AS MaxContainerRiskIndex,
       v.distdonekm AS DistDoneKm,
       v.distleftkm AS DistLeftKm,
       MAX(s.tempdevcount) AS MaxTempDevCount,
       MAX(s.critevents) AS MaxCritEvents,
       MAX(s.tempstabidx) AS MaxTempStabIdx,
       MAX(c.coolremainpct) AS MaxCoolRemainPct
FROM transportinfo v
JOIN container c ON c.containregistry = v.containtransit
JOIN sensordata s ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
GROUP BY v.vehiclereg, v.shiptransit, v.distdonekm, v.distleftkm
HAVING v.distdonekm / (v.distdonekm + v.distleftkm) * 100 < 50
   AND MAX((1 - (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx) * (1 - c.coolremainpct / 100.0)) > 0.4
ORDER BY MaxContainerRiskIndex DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT r.regmaintregistry AS EquipmentID,
       ROUND(r.compscore * (1 - r.incidents / 10.0), 2) AS MaintenanceComplianceScore,
       CAST(MAX(julianday(DATE('now')) - julianday(r.maintdatenext),
                julianday(DATE('now')) - julianday(r.calibdatenext),
                0) AS INTEGER) AS DaysOverdue,
       'Overdue' AS MaintenanceStatus
FROM regulatoryandmaintenance r
WHERE r.compscore IS NOT NULL
  AND r.compscore * (1 - r.incidents / 10.0) < 0.7
  AND (DATE('now') > r.maintdatenext OR DATE('now') > r.calibdatenext)
ORDER BY DaysOverdue DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT c.containregistry AS ContainerID,
         vd.vialtally * 10.0 / c.volliters AS SER,
         (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx AS TSS
  FROM container c
  JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
  JOIN sensordata s ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
),
efficient AS (
  SELECT * FROM metrics WHERE SER > 0.8 AND TSS > 0.9
)
SELECT ContainerID,
       ROUND(SER, 2) AS StorageEfficiencyRatio,
       ROUND(TSS, 2) AS TemperatureStabilityScore,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SER DESC) AS EfficiencyRank
FROM efficient
ORDER BY EfficiencyRank
LIMIT 5

WITH st AS (
  SELECT v.transmode AS TransportMode,
         v.vehiclereg AS VehicleID,
         (1 - s.handleevents / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) AS HQI,
         (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx AS TSS
  FROM transportinfo v
  JOIN sensordata s ON s.vehsenseref = v.vehiclereg
  WHERE s.alerttime >= DATETIME('now', '-3 months')
)
SELECT TransportMode,
       ROUND(AVG(HQI), 3) AS AvgHandlingQualityIndex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT VehicleID) AS VehiclesInvolved,
       COUNT(*) AS StableTransportCount
FROM st
WHERE HQI > 0.9 AND TSS > 0.8
GROUP BY TransportMode
HAVING AVG(HQI) > 0
ORDER BY AvgHandlingQualityIndex DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT c.containregistry AS ContainerID,
         c.coolremainpct AS CoolRemainPct,
         COUNT(s.sensortrack) AS SensorRows,
         MAX((1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx) AS MaxTSS,
         MAX(s.tempdevcount) AS MaxTempDevCount,
         MAX(s.critevents) AS MaxCritEvents,
         MAX(s.tempstabidx) AS MaxTempStabIdx,
         MAX(ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount) AS MaxTBS
  FROM container c
  LEFT JOIN sensordata s ON s.containlink = c.containregistry
  GROUP BY c.containregistry, c.coolremainpct
)
SELECT ContainerID,
       ROUND(MaxTSS, 3) AS MaxTemperatureStabilityScore,
       ROUND((1 - MaxTSS) * (1 - CoolRemainPct / 100.0), 3) AS ContainerRiskIndex,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (1 - MaxTSS) * (1 - CoolRemainPct / 100.0) DESC) AS RiskRank,
       CASE WHEN SensorRows = 0 THEN 'No Sensor Data' ELSE 'Sensor Data Available' END AS SensorDataStatus,
       json_object('TempDevCount', MaxTempDevCount,
                   'CritEvents', MaxCritEvents,
                   'TempStabIdx', MaxTempStabIdx,
                   'CoolRemainPct', CoolRemainPct,
                   'TempBreachSeverity', MaxTBS) AS DiagnosticSummary
FROM agg
ORDER BY RiskRank
LIMIT 10

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT s.containlink AS cid,
         (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx AS tss,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.containlink ORDER BY s.alerttime DESC, s.sensortrack DESC) AS rn
  FROM sensordata s
),
win AS (
  SELECT s.containlink AS cid,
         AVG((1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx) AS avgtss,
         MAX(ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount) AS maxtbs
  FROM sensordata s
  WHERE s.alerttime >= DATETIME('now', '-1 year')
  GROUP BY s.containlink
)
SELECT c.containregistry AS ContainerID,
       ROUND(w.avgtss, 2) AS AvgTemperatureStabilityScore,
       ROUND(w.maxtbs, 2) AS MaxTemperatureBreachSeverity,
       CASE
         WHEN (1 - l.tss) * (1 - c.coolremainpct / 100.0) > 0.6 OR l.tss < 0.4 THEN 'Critical'
         WHEN w.avgtss < 0.4 OR w.maxtbs > 1.5 THEN 'Unstable'
         WHEN w.avgtss >= 0.7 AND w.maxtbs <= 1.0 THEN 'Stable'
         WHEN w.avgtss >= 0.4 AND w.maxtbs <= 1.5 THEN 'Moderate'
       END AS ContainerHealthStatus
FROM container c
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.cid = c.containregistry AND l.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN win w ON w.cid = c.containregistry
LIMIT 100

SELECT sh.shipmentregistry AS ShipmentID,
       r.riskflag AS RiskStatus,
       SUM(r.incidents) AS IncidentCount,
       json_group_array(r.regmaintregistry) AS MaintenanceRecordIDs
FROM shipments sh
JOIN regulatoryandmaintenance r ON r.shipgov = sh.shipmentregistry
WHERE sh.integritymark = 'Compromised'
   OR sh.sealflag = 'Broken'
   OR sh.tampersign = 'Confirmed'
GROUP BY sh.shipmentregistry, r.riskflag
ORDER BY IncidentCount DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT s.vehsenseref AS VehicleID,
         (1 - s.handleevents / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) AS HQI,
         (1 - s.tempdevcount / 100.0) * (1 - s.critevents / 10.0) * s.tempstabidx AS TSS,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.vehsenseref ORDER BY s.alerttime DESC, s.sensortrack DESC) AS rn
  FROM sensordata s
)
SELECT v.vehiclereg AS VehicleID,
       v.shiptransit AS ShipmentID,
       ROUND(l.HQI, 3) AS HandlingQualityIndex,
       ROUND(l.TSS, 3) AS TemperatureStabilityScore
FROM transportinfo v
JOIN latest l ON l.VehicleID = v.vehiclereg AND l.rn = 1
WHERE l.HQI > 0.9 AND l.TSS > 0.8
ORDER BY l.TSS DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.containlink AS ContainerID,
         ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount AS TBS,
         s.tempdevcount AS TempDevCount,
         s.alertkind AS AlertKind
  FROM sensordata s
  WHERE ABS(s.tempnowc - s.storetempc) / s.temptolc * s.tempdevcount > 2.0
    AND s.tempdevcount > 5
)
SELECT ContainerID,
       MAX(TBS) AS TemperatureBreachSeverity,
       MAX(TempDevCount) AS TemperatureDeviations,
       json_group_array(AlertKind) AS AlertTypes
FROM m
GROUP BY ContainerID
ORDER BY TemperatureBreachSeverity DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH m AS (
  SELECT c.containregistry AS ContainerID,
         c.coolremainpct AS CoolRemainPct,
         (100 - c.coolremainpct) / (julianday(DATE('now')) - julianday(c.refilllatest)) AS CDR
  FROM container c
  WHERE c.refilllatest IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday(DATE('now')) > julianday(c.refilllatest)
)
SELECT ContainerID,
       CoolRemainPct AS CoolantRemainingPct,
       ROUND(CDR, 2) AS CoolantDepletionRate,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CDR DESC) AS DepletionRank
FROM m
WHERE CDR > 1 AND CoolRemainPct < 30
ORDER BY DepletionRank
LIMIT 5
